app.title: Image White Balancing Survey
landing.heading: Welcome
landing.intro: You will see several versions of the same photo, that are balanced differently. For each photo we ask which version looks best to you, and which one looks most correctly balanced. There are no right or wrong answers. Your responses are saved anonymously.
landing.tips: For the best results, use a computer or tablet screen and turn off any night mode or blue-light filter.

question.balanced: Which image looks balanced most correctly?
question.balacned.hint: A well-balanced image has no color cast: whites and greys look neutral.
question.best: Which image looks best to you?
question.best.hint: Pick the one you like the most.
slider.title: If your pick isn't quite right, adjust it with the sliders.
done.heading: Thank you!
done.body: Your answers have been saved. You can close this page now.
